newsitem.title: USA: Pamida Holdings Q3 same-store sales off.
newsitem.headline: Pamida Holdings Q3 same-store sales off.

text.p: Pamida Holdings Corp said Thursday comparable-store sales declined 2.7 percent for the third quarter and 2.6 percent for the fiscal year to date.
It said total sales for the quarter were $152 million compard with $176.2 million a year ago.
Sales for the nine months they were $439.6 million, down from $517.1 million the prior year but included sales from 40 unprofitable stores which have since been closed.

Chairman Steven Fishman in a statement said, "On the financial front, we have increased flexibility under our committed line of credit through the holiday season and have extended the committed line through March of 1999."
He said the company was making progress in improving margins and controlling costs.
Pamida also said it signed a long-term lease on a new distribution center in Lebanon, Ind., with operation expected to begin in July, 1997.
Earlier Thursday, the company posted third-quarter earnings of $0.02 per share.
